rationale: Link libBigWig.a objects directly with a hidden stderr shim and -Bsymbolic, because libbigwig0t64 ships no libBigWig.so.

import os, shlex, shutil, subprocess

def _static_libbigwig():
    """libbigwig0t64 ships no libBigWig.so on amd64, so -lBigWig falls back to the
    non-PIC libBigWig.a, which ld refuses to put into a shared object
    (R_X86_64_PC32 against stderr).  Unpack the archive and link its objects
    directly; a hidden stderr defined in a tiny shim makes the PC32 references legal."""
    cc = shlex.split(os.environ.get("CC") or "gcc")
    def find(name):
        p = subprocess.run(cc + ["-print-file-name=" + name], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
        return p if os.path.isabs(p) and os.path.exists(p) else None
    archive = find("libBigWig.a")
    if find("libBigWig.so") or not archive:
        return [], []
    d = os.path.join("build", "libbigwig-static")
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(d)
    subprocess.check_call(["ar", "x", archive], cwd=d)
    shim = os.path.join(d, "stderr_shim.c")
    with open(shim, "w") as f:
        f.write("struct _IO_FILE; typedef struct _IO_FILE FILE;\n"
                "extern FILE *fdopen(int, const char *);\n"
                "extern int setvbuf(FILE *, char *, int, unsigned long);\n"
                "__attribute__((visibility(\"hidden\"))) FILE *stderr;\n"
                "__attribute__((constructor)) static void bb_init(void) { stderr = fdopen(2, \"w\"); if (stderr) setvbuf(stderr, 0, 2, 0); }\n")
    objs = sorted(os.path.join(d, n) for n in os.listdir(d) if n.endswith(".o"))
    return objs, [shim]

_extra_objs, _extra_srcs = _static_libbigwig()
srcs.extend(_extra_srcs)
extra_link = ["-Wl,-Bsymbolic"] if _extra_objs else []
libs = ["m", "z"] if _extra_objs else ["BigWig", "m", "z"]
